Malice.

Malice!

MALICE!!

I don't like you. I hate you.
I want to kill you. I want to break you.
I resent you. I envy you. The sight of you offends me, so disappear————

Before it could become any of those words.
Without intelligence.

Malice.

Witless malice.

Nothing, and everything.
Empty, and overflowing.

If a name had to be given:

Darkness.

en.html:
Life loses to death...

Love, to time...

Bonds, to lies...

The defeat is absolute.

Love may be strong.
Very, very strong, even.

But darkness is always one step stronger than love.
That much is enough. Darkness wins.

In the end, what is evil takes the victory.
Every time.
